The '''Grumani Hierophants''' were a group of followers of the [[Grumani]] faith. They fought against the [[Spumani Crusader]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]] until the [[Republic Dark Age]], when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]] kept the Hierophants in check.
